title: Shōgun
lede: A drama set in 1600 Japan, followed from the real history people looked up to what they borrowed.
description: A time-ordered ripple map for Shōgun: each step dated and marked by how it was measured.
limits: Wikipedia stands in for all attention and one city's library for borrowing. Timing shows order. It does not prove the event caused each step on its own.
dataline: Wikimedia pageviews (daily), Seattle Public Library checkouts (monthly)
